infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MyJova uses the camera to take a selfie when you clock in or out.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: MyJova uses your location to verify you are at the worksite when you clock in.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow MyJova to use the camera for clock-in selfies.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow MyJova to use your location to verify worksite presence.
